defects.description: The renewable share of primary energy is given as 'one-seventh — roughly 34%', but one-seventh is about 14%, not 34%.
paraphrases: One-seventh is roughly 14%, so 'roughly 34%' does not match.
The fraction (one-seventh) and the percentage (34%) disagree.
34% is closer to a third than a seventh.
defects.rationale: Correct value 'roughly 14%' (one-seventh). Findable from the fraction and the figure in the same sentence, distinct.

defects.description: The share without renewables is given as 'the remaining two-sevenths', but if one-seventh is renewable the remainder must be six-sevenths, not two-sevenths.
paraphrases: One-seventh plus two-sevenths is three-sevenths, not the whole.
If one-seventh is renewable, six-sevenths is not, not two-sevenths.
The renewable and non-renewable fractions do not add up to one.
defects.rationale: Correct value 'six-sevenths' (complement of one-seventh). Findable from the stated renewable fraction, distinct.

defects.description: The renewable share of electricity is given as 'almost one-third, about 60%', but one-third is about 33%, not 60%.
paraphrases: One-third is about 33%, so 'about 60%' is wrong.
The fraction (one-third) and the percentage (60%) disagree.
60% is closer to two-thirds than one-third.
defects.rationale: Correct value 'about 30%' (~one-third). Findable from the fraction and the figure in the same sentence, distinct.
